prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity desktop app screenshot, 1440x960 landscape, of the Playness local Harness benchmark console. This is an incremental screen in an existing product, not a marketing page. Chinese interface. Flat practical UI with sophisticated typography and generous but efficient spacing, no glow/gradients/glass. Left sidebar 208px with cube logo Playness, workspace selector 'besiege', navigation 运行 / Benchmark (active) / Alice. Top bar breadcrumb Benchmark / 基准用例. Content heading 基准用例 and subtext '固定场景，可核对的改进。'. Segmented tabs 运行剖析 | 基准用例 active. Below, compact left case list of four entries: 接管中断 OFFLINE, WS 到期恢复 OFFLINE, 后台压缩 OFFLINE selected, 重复操作能力复用 LIVE. Show restrained result badges on list. Main area: title 后台压缩, badge 通过, small v1 / 离线, one line scope '原生 OMP · 模拟传输 · 256k'. Two selectors '本次执行' and '比较基线'. A row of four metrics with small baseline deltas: 摘要请求 1, 前台等待 42 ms, 尾部保留 100%, 悬空调用 0. Then an elegant checks table labeled 检查结果, three columns 检查项 / 实际结果 / 证据 with rows 候选只提交一次 ✓, 快照后历史完整 ✓, 晚到事件归属原周期 ✓, 取消后不提交 ✓. Small clickable seq labels '#18 → #31'. Footer detail line code revision, model none, fixed seed 7. Lower area recent execution rows with date/time, status and 查看运行 links. At top-right a secondary '复制运行命令' button. Include a muted note '模拟传输的耗时不代表在线模型性能。'. Avoid huge ornamental cards, giant headers, fake game screenshot, avatars, or excessive English jargon. Draw clean realistic product layout with clear hierarchy, legible compact Chinese typography and subtly bordered panels. All numbers are illustrative design placeholders only.
